request.query: What is the current processing fee for a NexaHome Loan?

answer.answer: For a NexaHome Loan sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01, the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned amount, with a minimum of ₹5,000 and maximum of ₹10,000, plus 18% GST [1][2]. If it was sanctioned before 2026-07-01, the fee that applied at sanction continues; under POL-HL-V3, that was 0.35%, with a minimum of ₹5,000 and maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST [1][2].

citations.quote: Processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST.
Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made.
All fees are exclusive of GST at 18%, which is charged additionally.
Processing fee is 0.35% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000, plus GST.

quality.reference_answer: For loans sanctioned on or after 1 July 2026 the processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned amount, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹10,000, plus 18% GST. This comes from circular CIR-2026-07, which replaced clause 6.2 of POL-HL-V3. Loans sanctioned earlier keep the fee that applied at their sanction.
